english.title: Fail to ensure welfare of animals delivered in containers to premises other than slaughterhouse
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the business operator]_
(B)_[a person engaged in the movement of animals delivered in containers]_

in respect of premises, other than a slaughterhouse, used for the killing of animals, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), failed to ensure that

(C)_[a container in which an animal was transported was handled with care and was not thrown, dropped or knocked over]_
(D)_[where possible, the container in which an animal was transported was loaded and unloaded horizontally and mechanically]_
(E)_[an animal delivered in a container with a perforated or flexible bottom was unloaded with particular care in order to avoid injury]_
(F)_[where appropriate, animals were unloaded from containers individually]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 30(1)(d) and 33(1) of, and paragraph 23 of Schedule 2 to, the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
